parsed.text: Panel p0 current estimates (represented_time 12) show both red and blue distributions uniform over the 4×4 grid at nodes n0–n3 (all 16 cells are tied maxima). Conditional candidate records differ only at node n2: under k0 blue peaks are the four cells in the first two rows of columns 2–3 while red peaks are the four cells in the first two rows of columns 0–1; under k1 blue peaks concentrate at cell [0,2] and red peaks at [0,1]; under k2 node n2 is uniform like the current view. Copied prior records in origins are not new estimates; candidate/command records are conditional estimates, not events that have already occurred.
